description: Envelope mutations. F1: every byte of 200 envelopes (1 to 16 recipients, 0 to 8 hops) flipped at bit (position mod 8), and every hex character of their hex fields replaced by the next hex digit: 1824865 mutations, kept here per (pass, region, verdict), at most 3 each, smallest envelopes first, plus any that verified ok. F2: the sealed part re-signed by another key. F8: wraps swapped between recipients. F9: the recipient list changed. D6: duplicate members. P2: number spellings of v, suite, ts and a hop's exp. R2: ts at the window's bounds. P3: bytes that are not JSON text, through the JSON reader alone and through envelope parsing.
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data: each comes from xorshiftRng(20261025) (packages/core/test/support/rng.ts). They are public; never let them protect anything real.
